prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1292; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was evaluated for a wrist fracture consistent with the mechanism of injury and the force described. Over the course of 18 visits, treatment followed a standard, expected progression, including immobilization, imaging follow-up, and graduated range-of-motion and strengthening exercises. Visit frequency decreased steadily as functional gains were made and pain subsided. Examination findings include localized tenderness and reduced grip strength over the affected area, which support the diagnosis. Other neurovascular and sensory tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same region is documented in available records. Billed services correspond to the care delivered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient is progressing well and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise. Follow-up will be scheduled as needed.
